model_note: The built-in tool did not expose the model name.

inputs.role: sole edit target, scene, camera, pose, expression, outfit and lighting
original facial and eye design, black bob and baseline fine linework; no pose, clothing or lighting transfer
original everyday closed-mouth smile identity; preserve the target expression
native eye structure, hair and single silver pin detail; summer outfit superseded
rounded collar, long sleeve bolero, ribbon and plaid skirt construction only

input_note: The original request used byte-identical frozen copies of these five inputs. A16 is waist-up; L1 was not applicable. The first input alone supplies scene, pose and camera.

review.method: Full source and selected PNG inspected; prior comparison also included native clothing, hand and face crops.
review.note: 頬杖と目線、顔・目・黒髪ボブ・銀ピンを保ち、服の細かな影面を整理。肘の主要なしわと布の立体感が残る。
limitations: 生成による微細な再描画差はある。厳密な領域マスクによる編集ではない。
